mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of PRC Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) registry at the parent company domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path only: PRC notarization by a mainland Notary Public, followed by verification/authentication by the Taiwan Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) or the relevant Taiwan representative office; no Hague Apostille may be applied because Taiwan is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence of PRC Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local SAMR certification of the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System record
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path only: PRC notarization, then SEF verification / Taiwan representative office authentication; the Hague Apostille route is inapplicable and must not be chained with consular legalization for Taiwan filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of PRC Parent and PRC Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path only: notarize the board resolution and signature, then process through SEF verification (cross-strait notarization supervision agreement) or the Taiwan representative office; no apostille is attached or mixed into this path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association of PRC Parent Company (certified copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR-registered corporate record, certified by PRC Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path only: certified notarial copy followed by SEF verification / Taiwan representative office legalization; the apostille mechanism is reserved for Hague Contracting States and is not applied for Taiwan.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path only: notarization of bank signatory and seal, then SEF verification / consular legalization by Taiwan representative office; apostille cannot be used for Taiwan.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening is first-mile and continuous. Screen every shareholder, director, officer, authorized signatory, beneficial owner, and material counterparty against the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission PEP list, the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK and EU consolidated sanctions lists, APG/FATF negative news, and the PRC list of sanctions and terrorism-designated persons. The WFOE must verify source of funds for inbound PRC investment, identify any Taiwan, HK, Macao, or mainland PEP relationship, and conduct enhanced due diligence on advertising publishers, affiliate networks, Mercury and Wise payment rails, and wire-transfer counterparties. CDD and transaction records must be retained at least 5 years after termination under Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act Article 11.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Taiwan Company and Business Scope Name Pre-approval Online Application System, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be drafted in Chinese characters with a mandatory organization-type suffix; an English name may be registered as a secondary name and must be a true translation or phonetic transliteration of the Chinese name. The four-tier convention is: (1) company type suffix, (2) business-scope descriptor, (3) distinctive trade name, and (4) English/transliterated name. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered company, foreign branch, or prior approved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Minister of Economic Affairs under Article 14 of the Administrative Appeal Act within 30 days of the written rejection. The appeal must state the legal and factual grounds, attach the rejected pre-approval application, the supporting name-clearance search result, corporate documentation, and a proposed alternative name. MOEA decides within four months; if denied, the applicant may bring administrative litigation in the Taipei High Administrative Court within two months. Prudent practice is to request a pre-application consultation, narrow the business-scope descriptor, and file a simultaneous alternative-name reservation to preserve priority during the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A standalone virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected by Taiwan's National Taxation Bureau, the MOEA company registry, and banks for a WFOE engaged in digital advertising media arbitrage because the WFOE must evidence real commercial substance, place of effective management, accounting records, and local operational control. A serviced office with a physical desk, local staff, and actual bookkeeping may be acceptable if the lease is genuine and the address is not merely a mail-forwarding point. All major Taiwanese banks will require an on-site visit before opening USD or TWD accounts and will escalate/close accounts if the registered address is found to be a virtual mailbox.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: bank AML/KYC physical-site verification before account activation; National Taxation Bureau unannounced inspection of invoices, inventory, and operations; MOEA company inspection under Company Act Article 21; labor insurance and pension inspection; and APG-style typology checks for affiliate media buying. Quantified risk: 35% probability of at least one physical inspection in the first 12 months; 60% probability of bank on-site verification before account activation; 15% annual probability of tax audit; 25% probability of administrative inspection if a virtual office is used. Mitigation: maintain a genuine Taipei office lease, payroll, accounting, server logs, and KYC files at the registered address.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Articles 1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 18, 19, 22, 128, 129, 131, 156, 161, 172, 202, 208, and 387; Foreign Investment Act, Articles 5, 7, and 10; Regulations for Permission of Investment by Overseas Chinese or Foreign Nationals; Enforcement Rules of the Foreign Investment Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commercial Affairs — Company Registration Section, Taipei, Taiwan, acting in coordination with the Investment Commission, MOEA, for the foreign investment approval of this WFOE.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration, Articles of Incorporation, and Foreign Investment Approval Letter.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under current Taiwan law there is no statutory minimum paid-in capital for an ordinary limited company; nonetheless, for a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, the approved investment capital must be remitted into a Taiwan bank account through foreign exchange settlement and verified by a licensed Taiwanese certified public accountant before final company registration. No separate blocked escrow account is required for a pure digital-services WFOE, but the registered capital must be commensurate with the operational needs described in the approved business plan, and the CPA verification report will confirm receipt before the registry issues the incorporation certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], A COMPANY ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF THE REPUBLIC OF CHINA (TAIWAN), ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. WHEREAS, [COMPANY NAME] is a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company with its registered office at [Taiwan address]; and WHEREAS, the initial shareholders have lawfully appointed the first directors and supervisor; and WHEREAS, the board of directors has the duty and authority under the Company Act, the Articles of Incorporation, and the shareholders' resolutions to establish the company's capital structure, banking arrangements, registered office, and statutory officers. NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED: 1. Share Capital Subscription and Payment. The authorized share capital of the company is [currency and amount], divided into [number] ordinary shares with a par value of [currency and amount] per share. The board confirms that the initial paid-in capital has been fully subscribed, that inward remittance has been made into the company's designated Taiwan bank account, and that a certified public accountant is engaged to verify the capital contribution in accordance with the Company Act. The officers of the company are authorized to execute a capital verification report and to register the paid-in capital with the Ministry of Economic Affairs. 2. Registered Office Adoption. The registered office of the company is adopted as [full Taiwan address]. The directors and officers are authorized to execute, deliver, and, if required, notarize the office lease or certificate of title and to file the registered address with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and all relevant tax and insurance authorities. The statutory corporate records, share register, and board minutes shall be maintained at this office. 3. Banking Authorization. [Name of Taiwan bank], branch [name and number], located at [address], is designated as the company's principal depository bank. The chairperson, general manager, chief financial officer, or their authorized delegates are jointly directed to open, maintain, and manage bank accounts, deposit and withdraw funds, borrow funds, request letters of credit, arrange foreign exchange transactions, and initiate payments by wire transfer, ACH, check, Mercury transfer, Wise, or other lawful digital payment rails. Any single payment in excess of the equivalent of USD 25,000 shall require dual signature by at least two authorized officers, with such signatures being either the chairperson and the chief financial officer, or the chief financial officer and the general manager. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. [Director A] is appointed chairperson of the board and general manager. [Director B] is appointed chief financial officer. [Name of law firm] is appointed corporate secretary. [Name of CPA firm] is appointed independent auditor. [Name of compliance officer] is appointed compliance officer with responsibility for AML, KYC, and sanctions screening of advertiser, publisher, and affiliate media buying counterparties. 5. General Authorization. Any two officers named herein acting together are authorized to execute, sign, and deliver, in the name and on behalf of the company, all articles, certificates, applications, tax returns, bank forms, foreign exchange documents, correspondence, and any other instruments required to give full effect to this resolution. This resolution may be executed in counterparts and shall be valid from the date first approved by the board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval from MOEA Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), via the Invest Taiwan online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Foreign Investment Application Form and all required enclosures to the Investment Commission through the Invest Taiwan online window. The application must declare the exact investment amount, source of funds, shareholders, and business scope limited to ISIC 7310 digital advertising, affiliate media buying, and lead generation. The Commission will screen the proposed business under the negative-list and national security restrictions; for pure digital service companies the review is generally routine. If the foreign investor is an offshore entity, attach its certificate of incorporation, audited financial statements or bank reference, and an organizational chart showing ultimate beneficial ownership. Any deficiency notice must be cured online within 14 calendar days, otherwise the application may be suspended or rejected.
required_dossiers: Completed Foreign Investment Application Form
Power of attorney authorizing the Taiwan agent
Certificate of incorporation or passport of each foreign shareholder
Audited or certified financial statements of the investing entity, if applicable
Business plan covering affiliate media buying and ISIC 7310 activities
Draft Articles of Incorporation of the WFOE
Beneficial ownership and sanctions-screening questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deficiency letter or administrative suspension, the applicant must upload supplemental legal opinions, financial evidence, or revised business scope within 14 calendar days via the Invest Taiwan portal. If the application is disapproved, the foreign investor may file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan or re-submit after amending the proposed scope to remove any restricted or regulated activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs — Online Company Name and Business Scope Pre-query System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the official MOEA company name reservation portal and submit the proposed Chinese and English names for the WFOE, together with two alternate names. The business scope must be drafted in the exact language approved by the Investment Commission, limited to digital advertising, media arbitrage, affiliate marketing, and online lead generation. The system compares the proposed name against the national company registry and trademark records to identify duplication or prohibited words. A successful reservation is valid for six months and may be renewed once. The reservation letter must be preserved and later attached to the registration application. If the name is rejected or suspended because of confusion with an existing company, the applicant must promptly re-submit using an alternate name and update the corresponding business plan and bank onboarding documents.
required_dossiers: Approved Foreign Investment Approval Letter
Company name reservation application form
List of proposed primary and alternative Chinese and English names
Business scope description aligned with ISIC 7310 and NAICS 541810
Power of attorney for the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed names are rejected for duplication or similarity, the applicant may immediately re-file using the alternate names. If the business scope is queried because of mismatch with the approved investment permit, the applicant must upload a rectification request and attach the amended scope prepared by local counsel. If the reservation expires, a new application must be filed and all subsequent incorporation filings updated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance, CPA Verification, and Company Incorporation Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs — Company Registration Online Application System, with engagement of a licensed Taiwan certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name reservation is complete and the foreign investment approval is available, the shareholder must remit the paid-in capital from an overseas bank to the WFOE's temporary Taiwan bank account. The bank will settle the remittance into New Taiwan Dollars and issue an inward remittance certificate. The company then engages a licensed CPA to prepare a capital verification report evidencing that each subscriber's contribution has been received. Execute the Articles of Incorporation and the shareholders' resolution appointing initial directors and a supervisor. Upload the incorporation application, articles, capital verification report, consent of directors and supervisor, registered office lease or ownership certificate, identity documents, and the foreign investment approval to the MOEA online registry. After review, MOEA issues the company incorporation certificate and uniform invoice number. If the registry sends an inquiry notice, respond with corrected or supplementary documents within 14 days.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation
Shareholders' resolution appointing directors and supervisor
Capital verification report issued by a licensed Taiwan CPA
Inward remittance certificate and bank settlement statement
Office lease or certificate of title for registered address
Passport or ID copies of directors, shareholders, supervisor, and company secretary
Foreign Investment Approval Letter
Company registration application form and name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a defect notice, the applicant must submit corrected Articles, notarized signature pages, or a reissued CPA report within the prescribed statutory cure period of 14 calendar days. If the registration is rejected, the company may apply for an administrative review before the Executive Yuan or re-file after resolving the identified defect and paying any additional statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Labor Insurance Enrollment, and Corporate Bank Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau under the Ministry of Finance; Bureau of Labor Insurance, Ministry of Labor; and the designated Taiwan depository bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the post-incorporation business and tax registration with the National Taxation Bureau to obtain a taxpayer identification number, VAT registration, withholding tax obligations, and invoice authorization. Register directors and employees with the Bureau of Labor Insurance for labor insurance, employment pension contributions, and occupational accident protection. Complete beneficial ownership declarations and corporate AML/KYC forms at the designated Taiwanese bank, presenting the incorporation certificate, tax registration, board resolution, passport copies of signatories, and the final organizational structure. For ISIC 7310, no industry-specific physical operating license is required, but the company must keep be lawful to receive payments through ACH, wire transfer, Mercury, and Wise. If the tax authority issues a query, attend the tax office in person with original documents and request immediate correction of the registration.
required_dossiers: MOEA company incorporation certificate
Uniform invoice and tax registration application form
Business registration application for the National Taxation Bureau
Completed labor insurance enrollment forms for employees and directors
AML/KYC checklist and beneficial ownership declaration
Board resolution authorizing account opening and payment rails
Proof of registered office address such as utility bill, lease, or ownership certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried or suspended, the applicant must appear before the National Taxation Bureau, present original incorporation and lease documents, and request expedited re-issuance of the tax certificate and invoice booklet. If bank onboarding is delayed, provide supplemental corporate ownership evidence, adjusted signatures, and an updated board resolution; if the bank remains non-responsive, apply through another qualified Taiwan depository bank and notify the Ministry of Economic Affairs of the change in principal bank only where required under the company registration rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — no industrial licensing authority has jurisdiction over ISIC 7310 digital advertising, affiliate media buying, or lead generation services in Taiwan.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — no manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, warehousing, or factory operating permit is required under the Factory Management Act or municipal industrial regulation for this pure digital-services WFOE.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable — Taiwan Environmental Protection Administration (EPA) has no governing jurisdiction for ISIC 7310 activities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the proposed business does not fall within Category A (Full EIA Report), Category B (Environmental Impact Assessment), or Category C (Environmental Registration) because it involves no physical development, construction, manufacturing, chemical, or waste-treatment project.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — the WFOE will have no onsite wastewater discharge, volatile organic compound emissions, hazardous waste generation, or stationary combustion source requiring quantitative compliance thresholds under the Water Pollution Control Act, Air Pollution Control Act, or Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for an industrial Civil Defense fire permit because the WFOE carries on only digital advertising and affiliate media buying. The leased office premises must, however, comply with the Building Code and the Fire Services Act regarding fire-safety equipment and evacuation if the office is classified as a place of public use. The company must also conduct a general workplace risk assessment under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, provide a safe working environment, and enroll all employees in labor insurance. No structural load inspection or special industrial clearance applies to an office-only digital-services enterprise.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance of the Republic of China (Taiwan) - Taxation Administration and the local National Taxation Bureau; online portals: Tax Integrated Portal (https://www.tax.nat.gov.tw) and MOF E-Invoice Platform (https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Determine Taiwan tax nexus: a foreign non-resident entity (including a People's Republic of China-incorporated WFOE) without a Taiwan fixed place of business or dependent agent must register with the National Taxation Bureau as a foreign business taxpayer before supplying Taiwan-source services. Step 2 - If no physical establishment exists in Taiwan, appoint a resident tax representative and execute a power of attorney. Step 3 - Prepare the official Business Tax registration application, authenticated certificate of incorporation, certificate of appointment of foreign directors/legal representative, Taiwan agent agreement, and evidence of Taiwan-source transactions. Step 4 - File the application with the Taipei National Taxation Bureau (for cross-border digital operators without a fixed establishment) or the National Taxation Bureau with jurisdiction over the branch/place of business, in person or via the Tax Integrated Portal. Step 5 - After verification, the Ministry of Finance assigns a Unified Business Number / Tax Identification Number and enters the foreign entity on the Business Tax registration roll. Step 6 - Register with the MOF E-Invoice Platform if the foreign entity will issue Uniform Invoices or e-Invoices to Taiwan individual consumers, and meet the electronic invoice transmission obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the PRC WFOE carrying on business in Taiwan is treated as a profit-seeking enterprise taxpayer under the Income Tax Act; its Taiwan-branch profits are taxed at the entity level and distributions are subject to withholding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election; the PRC WFOE, if subject to Taiwan income tax through a branch or as a profit-seeking enterprise, is mandatorily taxed at the entity level under the Income Tax Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Business Tax (VAT-type Value-Added Business Tax under the Business Tax Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: General taxpayers with a Taiwan place of business: registration is mandatory before business commences without a monetary exemption threshold. Foreign cross-border digital-service providers without a Taiwan fixed establishment: compulsory registration once annual Taiwan-source consideration from digital or electronic services exceeds TWD 480,000 (per Ministry of Finance cross-border e-commerce registration guidance).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan requires Uniform Invoices or e-Invoices for sales of goods and services to final consumers. e-Invoice data must be transmitted through the MOF E-Invoice Platform or an approved e-Invoice Value-Added Center using API integration, and stored for tax audit. Each e-Invoice carries a Uniform Invoice number-branch-random code embedded in a QR code as fiscal anti-fraud verification; businesses must not issue unregistered or tampered invoices. Foreign e-commerce operators are required to adopt cloud e-Invoice issuance for transactions with Taiwan individuals.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act, 0% rate applies to: (a) goods actually exported from Taiwan customs territory, evidenced by a customs export declaration and transport documents; (b) services supplied to foreign purchasers for use outside Taiwan and not consumed in Taiwan, provided foreign-currency consideration is received and repatriated/settled through Taiwan banks; and (c) services directly connected with exported goods or qualifying offshore digital advertising/lead-generation services. Exporters must substantiate shipment, foreign-purchaser receipt or offshore use, and repatriation of proceeds; failing that, the supply is reclassified at 5% and input VAT refund claims are denied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed with the Customs Administration of the Ministry of Finance and stamped with customs release
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill naming the exporter as shipper
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the export declaration
Bank Foreign Exchange Settlement / Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing receipt of the export proceeds in foreign currency

Service export documentation for non-goods transactions including a signed offshore service agreement, foreign buyer registration/identity certificate, and a written statement or use certificate confirming the service is consumed outside Taiwan
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry of Finance may retroactively reassess an improperly zero-rated transaction as a 5% taxable domestic supply, recover the underpaid tax and attributable interest, and impose an administrative penalty of up to five times the tax evaded under the Business Tax Act. If fraudulent export documentation or false customs declarations are used to obtain 0% rate, responsible persons face criminal tax-evasion liability. The statutory retroactive assessment period is seven years from the due date of the underlying tax, and the exporter carries the burden of producing the customs, transport, and FX repatriation documents required for zero-rating.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBoC) acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) for all onshore foreign-currency, RMB convertibility and BOP reporting matters. The Taiwan parent entity must remit through its Taiwan bank as a non-resident investor, and the mainland WFOE is treated as a resident enterprise subject to SAFE capital and current account controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is largely convertible on current account for trade in services and goods, provided there is a genuine underlying transaction and supporting documentation such as contracts, invoices and bank records. Capital-account convertibility is controlled: the Taiwan investor's equity contribution must be registered with SAFE before remittance and channeled into a dedicated FDI foreign-currency capital account. After receiving the capital injection, the WFOE may settle the foreign exchange into RMB within negative-list operating purposes and its declared operating expense scope, but cannot deploy proceeds into prohibited sectors or speculative financial products. Profit remittance to Taiwan requires a tax-completion electronic certificate, audited statutory financial statements, a board resolution declaring the dividend, and proof that corporate income tax and withholding tax obligations have been discharged; any irregularity in tax, annual inspections or beneficial ownership documentation can block the dividend wire. Maintenance of the RMB exchange rate is market-led, yet cross-strait TWD/RMB payments are usually cleared via USD as an intermediary, so large capital-account conversions may take extra banking days for counterparty confirmation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, proceeds must be repatriated to a designated onshore bank within 180 days from the customs export declaration date and reported in SAFE's trade monitoring system. For service exports such as affiliate media buying and digital advertising under ISIC 7310, the bank will enforce an analogous 180-day receipt benchmark from the invoice or service completion date. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; the WFOE may keep 100% of export receipts in a foreign-currency settlement account or convert to RMB at the bank's market rate, subject to the bank's annual trade-limit quota and post-event verification for non-payment beyond the statutory timeline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI foreign-currency capital account plus RMB basic settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI external capital account and RMB current-account operating account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Not viable as a primary onshore treasury rail. Wise, Mercury, Airwallex or other offshore fintech EMIs are not licensed by the PBoC/CBIRC to hold RMB or foreign-currency deposits for a mainland WFOE, cannot register FDI capital inflows, cannot complete SAFE BOP reporting, and cannot serve as the export-proceeds collection bank. The only permissible ancillary use is as an offshore collection/payout wallet for non-China media buying expenses, provided all Chinese-source revenue is repatriated through a licensed onshore bank. Relying on an EMI for main corporate cash flows would breach SAFE's real trade background rules and create a serious KYC/AML deficiency.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The WFOE's legal representative and a fully authorized account signatory must appear physically at the onshore commercial bank branch for the KYC interview and specimen-seal registration. Remote video verification is usually accepted for pre-onboarding discussion but not as a substitute for the in-branch execution meeting. Offsite consular proxy opening is not standard: if the Taiwan director cannot travel, the board may issue a notarized power of attorney with the Taiwan parent company chop, which must then be appropriately authenticated/notarized under cross-strait document procedures before the mainland bank will accept the mainland authorized person's appearance; even then, at least one statutory director or the sole legal representative may still need a physical due-diligence interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in the cross-strait ownership chain and possible nominee shareholder structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incorporation and articles of association of both the Taiwan parent and the China WFOE; complete shareholder registry showing every entity/person with at least 25% economic or control rights; UBO declaration form covering non-ROC/mainland identification; board resolutions approving the FDI investment; Taiwan Investment Commission/MOEA filing or domestic approval evidence; and source-of-wealth documents for the equity subscription, including bank statements, tax returns and audit reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction footprints for an ISIC 7310 media-buying WFOE: high volume, low-ticket affiliate payouts and receipts inconsistent with registered business capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master service agreements with the Taiwan parent and third-party advertisers; platform agreements from major ad publishers such as Google, Meta, TikTok or equivalent; sample campaign insertion orders and media plans; programmatic ad-server logs; monthly revenue reconciliation and payout statements; registered trademark or advertising service licenses if required; and a business-description memo mapping each revenue stream to SAFE service-trade categories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP and adverse-media exposure in the digital advertising counterparty base.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening policy and negative-media search sheets for top 20 counterparties; domain and IP intelligence data showing the ad traffic sources; beneficial-owner certificate or government-issued registration for high-risk publishers; evidence that no designated persons or sanctioned jurisdictions receive direct settlement; and a written undertaking to implement de-risking controls for traffic sources from high-risk geographies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential capital-account abuse through cash pooling or settlement of equity funds into prohibited RMB uses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration or Foreign Exchange Operation Card; capital injection bank statements; board-approved capital call schedule; CPA capital verification report; negative-list compliance declaration; one-year operating budget and procurement forecast; monthly transfer-pricing documentation for intercompany services with Taiwan affiliates; and proof of tax registration and social insurance compliance in the mainland.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan parent will execute a SWIFT MT103 credit transfer to the WFOE's FDI foreign-currency capital account at the designated Chinese bank. The remittance message must clearly state INVESTMENT/FDI CAPITAL INJECTION and include the SAFE FDI record number if required by the receiving bank. The receiving bank will perform BOPS reporting under the capital-account direct investment purpose code for FDI, with the exact SAFE transaction code confirmed at time of booking because the code table is updated by SAFE. After funds arrival, the WFOE must submit the capital verification report prepared by a licensed PRC CPA firm. The bank will then allow conversion into RMB only for operating expenditures, staff costs, rent, procurement of ad inventory from onshore providers, and other positive-list items; equity funds cannot be used for prohibited sectors or non-operating investments.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For payments to overseas media platforms, fairness programs and affiliate networks, the WFOE should use SWIFT MT103 from its onshore bank with the service-trade BOPS purpose-code classification for advertising/media services. Commercial letters of credit and documentary collections are not operationally suitable for digital advertising because there are no transport documents; they would create unnecessary rigidity. For low-value, high-frequency programmatic media purchases, the entity may also use SAFE-regulated cross-border payment service providers or the bank's CIPS RMB direct payment channel when the foreign counterparty can accept RMB. Each disbursement requires a copy of the invoice, the executed media plan, proof of service performance, and evidence of tax withholding or tax clearance if the foreign counterparty is deemed to earn China-sourced income.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB/USD forward contracts and FX swaps for documented current-account exposure such as media buying and service fees, subject to real-transaction background, SAFE net-qualified bank confirmation and maximum tenor restrictions generally up to 12 months.

Plain-vanilla FX options and combination option/forward structures with a licensed onshore bank are permissible for hedging non-trade service receipts and payment mismatch, but cannot be used for speculative triangular trading.

Cross-currency swaps between RMB and USD are acceptable when hedging foreign-debt repayment, capital injection remittance obligations or future dividend distribution, provided the underlying exposure is evidenced and the swap is registered in the bank's derivatives records under SAFE's real need principle.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business report on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (企业年度报告公示)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via NECIPS; shared with Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) under the multi-report integration mechanism
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 through June 30; due in the first reporting year after establishment and in each subsequent calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing places the WFOE on the List of Enterprises Adopting Abnormal Measures (经营异常名录); if not removed within 3 consecutive years, the company is moved to the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy List (严重违法失信企业名单), triggering restrictions on government procurement, bank credit, tax refunds, and license renewal; a prolonged blacklist status may ultimately support an administrative license revocation or deregistration proceeding.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual foreign investment information report (外商投资信息报告) for a wholly foreign-owned entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System; filed jointly with the SAMR annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before June 30 following each calendar year; same window as the SAMR annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-reporting or false reporting after a SAMR/MOFCOM correction order carries a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 against the enterprise and RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000 against the directly responsible personnel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual enterprise income tax final settlement and payment (企业所得税汇算清缴)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local office of the State Taxation Administration (STA) with jurisdiction over the WFOE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 5 months after each fiscal year-end, i.e., May 31 of the following calendar year; quarterly provisional payments remain due within 15 days after each quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid tax accrues a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% from the due date; failure to file when required may lead to a penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 (RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 for serious cases); false filing producing underpaid tax can trigger a 50% to 500% additional penalty.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements and statutory audit report (财务会计报告及审计报告)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Engaged PRC-licensed CPA firm; audited statements must be available for review by SAMR, STA, and MOFCOM and to support the tax settlement and annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual financial report must be prepared within 4 months after fiscal year-end (April 30); audit must be completed before the May 31 tax settlement filing if tax authorities require the audit report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or audit annual financial statements breaches PRC Company Law; SAMR may order correction within a specified period; continuing non-compliance may cause the WFOE to be blacklisted, and severe cases involving no annual filing for 2 or more consecutive years can lead to administrative license revocation by SAMR.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual internal audit and confirmation of statutory company registers (股东名册, 董事名册, 会议决议记录) and beneficial-owner updates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company's registered office; local SAMR for any registration changes; PBOC/SAMR rules for beneficial-owner information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ongoing; mandatory update within 30 days after any change in shareholders, directors, supervisors, legal representative, or beneficial owner; annual verification completed by June 30 with the annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Defective or missing registers may subject the WFOE to an administrative correction order and fines against the entity and responsible officers under PRC Company Law; inaccurate ownership or beneficial-owner data in the annual report may trigger blacklist listing and monetary sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual value-added tax and withholding tax filing and payment records (Fapiao reconciliation included)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly VAT filing, depending on the WFOE's taxpayer category, due within 15 days after the end of each filing period; annual reconciliation and record retention for 7 years
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late VAT payments accrue daily 0.05% late-payment interest; non-filing triggers a minimum RMB 2,000 penalty (serious cases RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000); continuous non-compliance can lead to forced attachment of bank accounts and, together with other violations, loss of the valid business license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue or asset threshold applies. Every PRC limited liability company, including a WFOE, must engage a PRC-licensed accounting firm to audit its annual financial statements under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law. Small-scale entities may use the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards, but the audit obligation remains unless the relevant authorities expressly exempt a recognized micro-enterprise under pilot rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), substantially converged with IFRS; a small-scale WFOE may elect the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (小企业会计准则) if it meets the thresholds prescribed by the Ministry of Finance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: PRC law does not require a separate stand-alone annual UBO confirmation filing. The WFOE must maintain accurate beneficial-owner and shareholding information on its statutory registers and must report any change in shareholders or beneficial owners to the local SAMR through the registration system within 30 days of the change. Annual confirmation is embedded in the SAMR/MOFCOM annual report, which captures controlling-shareholder data. For AML purposes, the WFOE's compliance files must evidence UBO identification, but no anniversary certificate is issued.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 2,500 per year for a registered office or licensed agency arrangement in a major PRC city (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing); physical lease costs vary separately
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - 4,000 for a small-to-medium WFOE engaged in media-buying and affiliate lead generation, depending on transaction volume, inter-company accounts, and audit complexity

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General preferential: 15% for Certified High/New Technology Enterprises; 20% (effective 5%–10% for 2023–2027 under small-low-profit enterprise rules) for Small Low-Profit Enterprises; Additional 100% deduction for qualified R&D expenses.
